title: Contract #984: drop the change-thread tables and runner_dispatches.mode once no release reads them

story.i_want_to: have the tables and column Epic 45 left behind dropped in a release after #984's is live on every machine
story.so_that: the rolling deploy that removed the code never ran against a schema its predecessor could not read

rationale: #984 shipped as the EXPAND half: its migration (20261018120000_retire_change_thread_modes) only narrows CHECKs, because Fly's release_command runs before a rolling deploy and the previous release's DispatchRecord still selects and inserts runner_dispatches.mode and its thread crons still read the thread tables. Once that release is gone, nothing reads them.

acceptance_criteria.description: A migration drops thread_entries, thread_reviews, thread_issue_links, thread_checkpoints, claim_routes, browser_sessions and webauthn_login_challenges, in FK order, IF EXISTS.
The same migration drops the runner_dispatches_mode CHECK and the runner_dispatches.mode column.
It deletes oban_jobs of ThreadMergeWorker, ThreadMergeSweepWorker, ThreadIssueLinkWorker and ReviewCeilingWorker again, catching any the previous release's crons enqueued during the #984 rollout.
It merges only after the #984 release is the only one running in production (fly status shows every machine on that image or later).

test_cases.name: contract migration
expected_results: the seven tables and runner_dispatches.mode no longer exist
no oban_jobs row names a retired worker

technical_notes: down raises: nothing reads the dropped tables. CHANGELOG entry lists the dropped tables (operator-facing migration).
